purpose: Source-backed forensic event replay benchmark for Netflix's Worst Roommate Ever cases. Netflix is used as the episode inventory; factual truth labels come from official, court, law-enforcement, and reputable journalism sources.

notes: The official Netflix/Tudum title page lists two seasons. Season 1 has five episodes and Season 2 has four episodes.

The Season 2 Tudum article describes the Tammy Fritz and Scott Pettigrew stories in a different episode-number order than several catalog-style listings. This dataset follows the commonly indexed title order: S2E1 My BFF Tried to Kill Me, S2E2 Housemate from Hell, S2E3 Burning Down the House, S2E4 The Lethal Landlord.
Birth charts are intentionally out of scope. The benchmark only replays documented event or response anchors.

benchmark_policy.runnable_policy: Runnable cases require a documented local date, time or tight response-time anchor, timezone, and location. Discovery, last-seen, welfare-call, or probable-sequence anchors are labeled as such and are not represented as exact death times unless a source says so.
benchmark_policy.holdout_policy: Cases without a precise or tight public event time remain in the inventory but are excluded from live route scoring.
